knifley-chapel-bic-knifley-ky.assessment: Knifley Chapel BIC is part of the cluster of Brethren in Christ congregations in Adair County, Kentucky, which dates back to early 20th-century BIC missions in the region. Pastor Jordan Burton leads. The rural Kentucky BIC community maintains strong Anabaptist-Pietist-Wesleyan witness in a Southern Baptist-dominated region. Yellow rating per denominational caveat (BIC ordains women); local male leadership and Anabaptist heritage provide balance for evaluation.

score_notes.gender: Verified male senior pastor Jordan Burton; BIC denomination ordains women.
